content:
alex: FYI eu-west-1 cluster is at 98% GPU util for the last 20m. Latency SLOs for short-chat routes are drifting high. Seeing unusually large batches forming repeatedly.

mira: Confirmed - dashboard shows continuous growth in max_batch for the chat-cpu-optimized kernel. Tail p95->p99 jumped about 200ms over baseline.

sam: Any recent fleet changes? autoscaler, packer, or config flip?

alex: No manual deploys. We had a big customer demo in eu-west that started ~07:50 UTC. Traffic pattern is many low-token requests in quick succession. Batcher keeps grouping them into 2–4k token-equivalent batches, which kills latency.

tess: That demo traffic is the classic opposite of what packing likes — lots of tiny requests but high arrival rate so packer tries to maximize GPU utilization and ends up with huge max_batch windows.

mira: Stack shows admission controller letting large batches through because max_batch config is per-kernel and set conservatively for throughput. We never set a hard per-request latency override.

sam: Can we throttle packing for that model family/region? Maybe a per-route max_batch cap or prefer single-request fast path?

alex: Immediate mitigation idea: reduce model-kernel max_batch for eu-west routing tier from 4096 -> 512. That should cut the packing-induced tail but increase token-cost a bit. Worth doing short-term?

mira: +1, but we need to be careful with rollout — change touches many nodes. I can push a staged config to one shard first.

tess: Also consider priority preemption: force low-latency routes to bypass batching and go to a latency-optimized queue. We have the preempt slot logic but it's off for this kernel.

sam: For now, do both: 1) staged max_batch reduction on eu-west, 2) enable preempt slots for /chat/short route. Should cut p99 quickly.

infra-bot: action_created: ticket #INF-3421 created: "eu-west packing -> reduce max_batch + enable preempt for short-chat" assigned to @mira. ETA 30m.

mira: Pushing config to shard-3 now. Command I ran: 
```
kubectl -n runtime set configmap kernel-config --from-file=max_batch=512 --context=cluster-eu-west && ./ops/deploy-config --shards=shard-3
```

alex: Logs from shard-3 after change show immediate shrink in batch sizes, request grouping now mostly <600 tokens per batch.

mira: Rolling to other shards (shard-1, shard-2) — doing 60s interlock.

tess: Enabling preempt slots for route: 
```
curl -X POST "$ROUTER/api/v1/routes/chat-short/actions" -d '{"preempt_slot":true,"max_latency_ms":120}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

sam: After shard-1 done, p95 back to baseline, p99 still elevated but trending down.

alex: CPU on the router pods increased ~15% after preempt enable — expected. Cost impact is fine short-term.

mira: Full roll complete. Observed p50/p95 stable. p99 reduced from +220ms to +40ms above baseline.

tess: We should add an automated rule: when consecutive 5m GPU util > 90% and median batch_size > 1000, auto-apply a regional max_batch cap and enable preempt slots for latency routes for 15m. Rollback after util drops.

sam: Agreed, and surface the cost delta estimate in the alert so product teams know why latency->cost tradeoff triggered.

alex: Also noticed KV cache churn on the large batches: repeated cold-starts of KV for the chat model increased token work. Shortening batches reduces KV thrash; that's part of the latency improvement.

mira: Next steps: open RFC for regional adaptive admission. I'll draft and include metrics (GPU util, median batch size, p99 tail).

infra-bot: status: ticket #INF-3421 updated: "rollout complete, post-incident follow-up assigned to mira".

sam: Thanks team. I'll prepare a short blameless note for the customer that had the demo so they have context.

alex: Follow-up: can we add a synthetic test that emulates many tiny concurrent requests to catch this in staging? Would've caught demo pattern.

tess: Good call — I'll coordinate with QA to add a load profile.

mira: RFC draft link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/INF-adaptive-admission (WIP)

infra-bot: deploybot: config-change deployed to shards [1..3] by mira at 08:52 UTC.

sam: Closing thread, keep monitoring for 2 hours. Ping here if p99 > +100ms again. :thumbsup:
